reconstruction.scope: Specific mapped Banteay Samré: low laterite outer enclosure and four open gates; inner sandstone gallery with true open passages and window recesses; tall stepped lotus-bud sanctuary on a moulded plinth, eastern mandapa and two separately based libraries, corbelled roofs, original simplified pediment rims and stairs. Inner courts retain native ground. Heights, unmapped hall/library placement, surviving roof details and exact carving are picture-led approximations.
